scripts.typecheck: bun run check:workspace && bun run check:ts-only && bun run --filter @goldenbee/sdk typecheck && bun run --filter goldenbee-web typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run check:ts-only && bun run --filter @goldenbee/sdk lint && bun run --filter goldenbee-web lint
scripts.test: bun run check:workspace && bun run check:ts-only && bun test && bun run --filter goldenbee-web test
